meta.name: Triage and remediate DevOps alerts with Claude, ClickUp, GitHub and Slack

parameters.content:
## AI DevOps Knowledge & Runbook Agent

Connects GitHub, ClickUp, Terraform, monitoring, and internal documentation so that when an alert fires, the agent automatically pulls the matching runbook and prior incidents, drafts a remediation plan, and either executes safe, pre-approved fixes or hands a fully-briefed ticket to the on-call engineer — with a hard fail-safe that pages a human immediately for any critical production outage, bypassing AI-driven remediation entirely.

### How it works
1. Webhook - Monitoring Alert Received receives the alert payload (service, alert type, severity, message, metric values) from your monitoring/alerting system.
2. Claude classifies the alert: affected service, alert type, assessed severity, suspected root-cause category, and whether it looks like a critical production outage.
3. IF - Critical Production Outage Detected? is checked FIRST and independently of everything else — any critical outage goes straight to an urgent ClickUp incident ticket + immediate on-call page, no AI remediation planning, no auto-execution path.
4. Everything else proceeds to knowledge retrieval: matching runbook docs, related GitHub issues/PRs, previous ClickUp incident tickets, and current Terraform workspace state are all pulled and combined into one context bundle.
5. Claude drafts a remediation plan strictly from that retrieved context: root-cause hypothesis, step-by-step remediation, a specific action type/command, risk level, and confidence.
6. JS - Check Auto-Remediation Eligibility compares the plan against a configured allowlist of safe, low-risk action types before anything is ever auto-executed.
7. Eligible plans are executed automatically, logged as a resolved ClickUp ticket, and posted to the DevOps channel. Everything else opens a ClickUp incident ticket with the full plan and runbook context and pages the on-call engineer for manual review.
8. All three paths (critical bypass, auto-remediated, manual escalation) converge and are logged to the incident knowledge log so future retrievals get smarter over time.

### Setup
1. Import this workflow into n8n and activate it.
2. Add credentials: GitHub API, ClickUp API, your documentation/runbook knowledge base API, Terraform Cloud/Enterprise API, your remediation-executor API, Anthropic Claude, and Slack.
3. Edit Set - Config: GitHub owner/repo, ClickUp list ID, runbook KB URL, Terraform workspace ID, remediation executor URL, incident log URL, Slack channels, and the auto-remediation allowlist.
4. Run once with a sample alert payload to confirm classification, retrieval, planning, and routing all work end to end before activating for real alert traffic.

## Stage 1: Intake & AI Triage

- **Webhook - Monitoring Alert Received** — receives the incoming alert from your monitoring/alerting system (service, alert type, severity, message, metrics).
- **Set - Config** — central place for GitHub, ClickUp, Terraform, runbook KB, remediation executor, and Slack settings.
- **Anthropic - Triage & Remediation Model** — the Claude model shared by the triage and planning agents. 🔑
- **AI Agent - Classify & Triage Alert** — classifies the affected service, alert type, severity, suspected root-cause category, and whether it's a critical production outage.
- **JS - Parse Triage Output** — safely parses Claude's classification, defaulting to a critical-outage flag if parsing fails.

## Stage 2: Safety Fail-Safe & Knowledge Retrieval

- **IF - Critical Production Outage Detected?** — branches straight to an immediate page if the classifier flagged a critical outage.
- **ClickUp - Create Critical Incident Ticket (Immediate)** — opens a top-priority incident ticket right away. 🔑
- **Slack - Page On-Call Engineer (Immediate)** — pages on-call immediately for critical outages, before any AI planning happens. 🔑
- **HTTP - Search Runbook Knowledge Base** — retrieves the matching runbook/documentation for this alert type and service. 🔑
- **GitHub - Search Related Issues & PRs** — pulls related past issues/PRs from the affected service's repo. 🔑
- **ClickUp - Search Previous Incident Tickets** — retrieves prior incidents for this service/alert type. 🔑
- **HTTP - Get Terraform Workspace State** — pulls current infrastructure state/outputs for the affected workspace. 🔑
- **JS - Aggregate Retrieved Context** — combines runbook, issues, incidents, and Terraform state into one context bundle.
- **AI Agent - Generate Remediation Plan** — drafts a root-cause hypothesis and step-by-step remediation plan strictly from the retrieved context.
- **JS - Parse Remediation Plan Output** — safely parses the plan, defaulting to manual-only if parsing fails.

## Stage 3: Eligibility, Execution & Logging

- **JS - Check Auto-Remediation Eligibility** — compares the plan's action type, risk level, and confidence against the configured safe-action allowlist.
- **IF - Safe to Auto-Remediate?** — routes to automated execution or manual escalation.
- **HTTP - Execute Automated Remediation Action** — calls your remediation executor to run the approved fix. 🔑
- **ClickUp - Create Ticket (Auto-Remediated)** — logs the automated fix as a resolved ticket for the record. 🔑
- **Slack - Notify Auto-Remediation Executed** — posts confirmation to the DevOps channel. 🔑
- **ClickUp - Create Incident Ticket (Manual Remediation Needed)** — opens a ticket with the full plan and context for a human to act on. 🔑
- **Slack - Alert On-Call with Remediation Plan & Runbook** — notifies on-call with the plan, runbook link, and prior-incident context. 🔑
- **Merge - Combine Resolution Branches** — merges the critical, auto-remediated, and manual-escalation paths back into one flow.
- **HTTP - Log Incident & Outcome to Knowledge Base** — records the alert, plan, and outcome so future retrievals improve. 🔑
